records.name: Mastering Mixology access, observation boundary, and fixed rewards

recipe_coverage.boundary: A level gate only establishes which recipe bases can appear. It does not establish hopper contents, order assignment, processing, XP, resin, or a session result.

session.accepted_inputs: A clean, unnoted eligible herb or its matching unfinished potion is consumed into a fixed category and quantity of untradeable paste.
session.input_boundary: Clean-herb and unfinished-potion inventory, designated expendable quantities, paste balances, and ordinary-potion reserve needs must be explicitly observed. No input is assumed expendable.
session.resin_boundary: Mox, Aga, and Lye resin are awarded only from observed order results. The model does not calculate or create paste, resin, XP, hand-ins, or output.

prescription_goggles.effect: 10% chance to save a secondary ingredient when mixing ordinary potions.

reagent_pouch.effect: Stores up to 26 of each Herblore secondary ingredient.

potion_storage.effect: One-time potion, unfinished-potion, and vial bank storage feature.

alchemists_amulet.effect: 15% chance for an extra ordinary-potion dose; chance outcomes and charge use are observed.

chugging_barrel.effect: Assembled barrel stores up to five potion types, 100 doses each.
chugging_barrel.boundary: Assembly and stored contents are observed; dismantling loses stored potions.

herb_sack_boundary.standard_herb_sack: Not a Mixology reward. Canonical ownership, capacity, and acquisition paths remain durable-utility-herb-sack in data/facts/durable-utility-items.json.
herb_sack_boundary.silklined_herb_sack: One observed Pristine spider silk can permanently upgrade an owned standard Herb sack. A Sarachnis kill, silk drop, upgrade, or capacity state is never inferred here.
